about: Value/quote pairs for the quote-support check (app/service.py SUPPORT_QUESTION). YES: the quote states the value, often in other words. NO: it states something else, or nothing about it. Written to mirror the 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-06 measurements: normalised values that must read as stated, blunt wrong copies, and subtle scope changes. Ground truth; never edited to make a model pass.
